profile.text: Anat, former acting curator of Sargon's Varjavandabad Museum. She has always wanted to travel across this great land, and after experiencing a series of odd events at the museum, she set out on the journey of her dreams. She now works with Rhodes Island's Sargon office as a field operator under the codename Papyrus, providing theoretical support and guidance for Rhodes Island's local historical research.
